# pub-publish.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Publish to pub.dev.</link-summary>

```text
Publishes the package a release tag names to pub.dev with automated publishing: pub.dev accepts
the OpenID Connect token of the publish job, so no credential is stored anywhere.

On pub.dev, every package names the repository, the tag pattern (v{{version}}, or
<package>-v{{version}} in a workspace) and, recommended, the environment of this workflow. pub.dev
only accepts runs started by the push of such a tag; the token carries the caller's repository,
event and ref, so calling this workflow from another repository works.

The caller grants id-token: write.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  pub-publish:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/pub-publish.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `discovery` | string | empty | Packages discovered before; empty discovers them here. |
| `include` | string | empty | Globs of package directories outside the workspace. |
| `exclude` | string | empty | Globs of package directories to leave out. |
| `tag` | string | empty | The release tag; empty takes github.ref_name. |
| `tag-patterns` | string | `{"single":"v{version}","package":"{package}-v{version}"}` | JSON object of tag patterns with {package} and {version}. |
| `release-branch` | string | `main` | Branch the tagged commit has to be on; empty skips the check. |
| `environment` | string | `pub.dev` | GitHub environment of the publish job; the same name as in the pub.dev settings. Empty publishes without one. |
| `dry-run` | boolean | `false` | Only run pub publish --dry-run. |
| `skip-existing` | boolean | `true` | Succeed without publishing when the version is already on pub.dev, for reruns. |
| `wait-for-siblings` | boolean | `true` | Wait until the sibling packages this one depends on are on pub.dev. |
| `wait-attempts` | number | `60` | How often to ask pub.dev for a sibling. |
| `wait-interval` | number | `30` | Seconds between two attempts. |
| `sdk` | string | `stable` | Dart SDK (stable, beta or a version). |
| `flutter-version` | string | `stable` | Flutter version for Flutter packages. |
| `pre-publish` | string | empty | Shell commands run in the package directory right before the publication. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `45` | Timeout of the publish job, including the wait for siblings. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `package` | The published package. |
| `version` | The published version. |
| `published` | true when this run published the version. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `contents: read`
- `id-token: write`
